scope: Four missing EFI and Subway parallax layers; no shared renderer or catalogue edits by this production task

reference.role: Existing project backplate: style, palette, camera, environment continuity

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent middle-depth parallax overlay for an existing 2D fighting game stage, 1600 x 900 landscape. The input image is a strict style, perspective and lighting reference only; do NOT reproduce its opaque background. Create an independently compositable RGBA overlay for this abandoned EFI industrial factory. At the extreme LEFT edge, a slim bundle of aged dark steel vertical conduit pipes, their wall brackets, one small corroded electrical junction box with two tiny amber indicator lamps. At the extreme RIGHT edge, two narrow steel pipes and a rusty elbow bend. These are sparse edge framing elements: all visible geometry must stay within the outermost 12 percent on either side. Geometry meets the ground around source y=735. Match the reference's blue gray tarnished metal, rusty yellow accents, upper left soft daylight and very restrained amber local light, realistic painted game environment detail. Maintain the same straight-on side-view camera and scale. Every part of the central region x=200..1400 must be fully transparent, as must the space behind and between the pipes. No characters, no creatures, no text, no labels, no UI, no black/white background, no checkerboard drawn in the image, no opaque wall, no floor plane, no fog plate, no collage, no asset grid. Output only this single overlay with genuine alpha transparency.

visual_review.observations: Sparse edge geometry; open central fighting band; no character, UI, text or opaque background. Foreground rubble is confined to lower corners outside the fighting band.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent foreground parallax overlay for the referenced 2D fighting game subway stage, 1600 x 900 landscape. Use the image as exact style, perspective and lighting reference, not as an edit target to reproduce. Draw sparse independently compositable close foreground details: two very dark damaged metal conduit ends with loose insulated cables hanging from the extreme top LEFT corner, short loose cable loops at the extreme top RIGHT corner; near each bottom corner, a small angular pile of broken off-white subway tiles and concrete with tiny deep-blue tile fragments. Cables confined to x=0..170 or x=1430..1600 and y=0..240, debris confined to outermost 11 percent and y=760..900. All foreground elements have dark blue-gray shadow masses, subtle cyan rim illumination with just a little reflected orange on the far left, matching the reference. Center x=200..1400 must be completely transparent throughout; keep the fighters and the platform floor fully unobstructed. No character, no train, no solid pillars, no station background, no floor plane, no roof across the middle, no text, no signs, no UI, no added gore, no solid backdrop or checkerboard. Output a single polished parallax foreground overlay with true alpha transparency.

visual_review.observations: Sparse edge geometry; open central fighting band; no character, UI, text or opaque background. Foreground rubble is confined to lower corners outside the fighting band.

validation.alpha_note: The central fighting band is alpha 0 except isolated residual alpha 1 values (1/255 opacity); no visible opaque plate. Foreground corner debris extends below the fighting band.
validation.resolution_note: Native generated output is 1672 x 941, nearly 16:9, preserved byte for byte; stage renderer must scale the full canvas using its existing background rectangle.

fidelity_limits: These overlays continue the existing project backplates. They are original game illustrations, not extracted official episode assets.
No pixel-for-pixel comparison against official in-game camera captures has been performed; canonical 1:1 fidelity is not certified.
Final engine compositing and camera-drift review are performed by the integration task.
